description: 🇮🇳 Free, open-source AI coding agent for your terminal and browser. Plans, edits, runs your tests and verifies its own work. Use any model: Ollama and local LLMs offline, or your own Claude, GPT, Gemini or DeepSeek keys. No account, no subscription. MIT.
summary: Local AI coding agent for your terminal. Open-source, offline alternative to Claude Code, Cursor & Copilot — powered by Ollama and any local LLM. Private by default, free forever.
